card.name: Inside drug names before -oxil, -yl
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a long drug name just before its ending, such as the 'iv' in Adefovir Dipivoxil or 'eth' in icosapent ethyl. It also fires on 'rop' in isopropyl and 'ethyl' in a chemical name.

modes.label: Adefovir Dipivoxil
modes.description: The 'iv' piece inside the name Adefovir Dipivoxil, before 'oxil'.
modes.example: ificantly increased drug exposures were seen when Adefovir Dip<<iv>>oxil Tablets was administered to adult patients

modes.label: Ester names ending in -yl
modes.description: The piece just before the '-yl' ending in drug and chemical names like icosapent ethyl or omidenepag isopropyl.
modes.example: Advise patients to swallow icosapent<< eth>>yl capsules whole.

card.writes: It seems to help the model finish the rest of a long drug name, such as the 'oxil' or 'yl' ending, rather than start a new word.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long drug name, just before the ending is spelled out.
